steps.instruction: Raise both hands to your shoulders and say 'Allahu Akbar' to begin the prayer with your intention.
Recite the opening supplication (Dua al-Iftitah) quietly while standing.
Seek refuge in Allah from Satan silently before starting the recitation.
Recite the Basmala aloud as it is an integral verse of Surah Al-Fatiha.
Recite Surah Al-Fatiha clearly and aloud. This is a fundamental pillar of Salah.
Say 'Ameen' aloud after completing Surah Al-Fatiha.
Recite another complete Surah or a few verses from the Holy Quran aloud.
Say 'Allahu Akbar' and bow down, placing your hands on your knees with a straight back, glorifying Allah.
Rise up from bowing to a fully upright standing position while raising your hands.
Stand straight calmly and recite the praise of our Lord.
Say 'Allahu Akbar' and prostrate, ensuring seven body parts touch the ground, glorifying Allah.
Say 'Allahu Akbar' and sit up calmly on your left foot (Iftirishah posture), reciting the supplication.
Say 'Allahu Akbar' and perform the second prostration exactly like the first one.
Rise up to the second Rakah, stand straight, and seek refuge in Allah.
Recite the Basmala aloud before starting the Fatiha recitation.
Say 'Ameen' aloud upon completing the Fatiha.
Say 'Allahu Akbar' and bow down into Ruku.
Rise back to the standing position (Qawmah).
Stand firmly and recite the praise of Allah.
While remaining standing, raise both hands to chest level and recite the Qunoot supplication aloud.
Say 'Allahu Akbar' and descend directly into the first prostration.
Sit up between the two prostrations and make your supplication.
Perform the final prostration of the prayer.
Sit in the Tawarruk position (hip on the ground) and recite the greetings of faith, lifting your right index finger at 'Illallah'.
Send blessings upon Prophet Muhammad and his family, and Prophet Ibrahim and his family.
Recite the recommended final supplication seeking protection from the four trials.
Turn your face to the right saying the Salam to conclude, then repeat to the left.
Raise hands and make Takbir to start Dhuhr prayer.
Bow down into Ruku and praise Allah.
Sit up between the two prostrations.
Stand for Rakah 2 and seek refuge.
Sit in Iftirishah posture for the first Tashahhud and recite greetings.
Send blessings upon the Prophet before standing up.
Rise up to Rakah 3 and seek refuge.
Recite Surah Al-Fatiha silently (No extra surah is read here).
Rise up to the final Rakah and seek refuge.
Sit in Tawarruk position for final Tashahhud and recite greetings.
Send complete blessings upon the Prophet and Ibrahim.
Turn your face right then left saying Salam to finish.
Raise hands and make Takbir to start Asr prayer.
Sit up between the two prostrations.
Stand for Rakah 2 and seek refuge.
Sit in Iftirishah posture for the first Tashahhud and recite greetings.
Send blessings upon the Prophet before standing up.
Rise up to Rakah 3 and seek refuge.
Recite Surah Al-Fatiha silently (No extra surah).
Rise up to the final Rakah and seek refuge.
Sit in Tawarruk position for final Tashahhud and recite greetings.
Send complete blessings upon the Prophet.
Turn face right then left saying Salam to finish.
Raise hands and make Takbir to start Maghrib.
Stand for Rakah 2 and seek refuge.
Sit in Iftirishah posture for first Tashahhud and recite greetings.
Stand for the final Rakah and seek refuge.
Sit in Tawarruk position for final Tashahhud and recite greetings.
Send complete blessings upon the Prophet.
Turn face right then left saying Salam to finish.
Raise hands and make Takbir to start Isha.
Stand for Rakah 2 and seek refuge.
Sit for the first Tashahhud and recite greetings.
Rise up to Rakah 3 and seek refuge.
Rise up to the final Rakah and seek refuge.
Sit in Tawarruk position for final Tashahhud and recite greetings.
Send complete blessings upon the Prophet.
Turn face right then left saying Salam to finish.
Begin the 2 Rakah Sunnah prayer before Fajr.
Recite an additional Surah silently (e.g., Al-Kafirun).
Stand for Rakah 2 and seek refuge.
Recite an additional Surah silently (e.g., Al-Ikhlas).
Sit in Tawarruk position for final Tashahhud.
Turn face right then left saying Salam to finish.
Begin the Witr prayer with Takbir.
Recite an additional Surah silently (e.g., Al-A'la).
Stand for Rakah 2 and seek refuge.
Recite an additional Surah silently (e.g., Al-Kafirun).
Stand for the final Rakah and seek refuge.
Recite an additional Surah silently (e.g., Al-Ikhlas).
Rise up from Ruku into standing position.
Recite Dua al-Qunoot aloud during Qawmah (prescribed in Shafi'i for the second half of Ramadan).
Sit in Tawarruk posture for final Tashahhud and recite greetings.
Send complete blessings upon the Prophet.
Turn face right then left saying Salam to finish.
Raise hands and make Takbir to start Jumu'ah prayer.
Recite Surah Al-Fatiha aloud with the Imam.
Listen to the Imam reciting a Sunnah Surah (e.g., Al-A'la or Al-Jumu'ah) aloud.
Stand for Rakah 2 and seek refuge.
Recite Surah Al-Fatiha aloud with the Imam.
Listen to the Imam reciting a Sunnah Surah (e.g., Al-Ghashiyah or Al-Munafiqun) aloud.
Sit for final Tashahhud and recite greetings.
Send complete blessings upon the Prophet.
Turn face right then left saying Salam to finish.
Raise hands and make Takbir to start Eid prayer.
Perform 7 extra Takbirs, reciting the specific Dhikr between each.
Recite Surah Al-Fatiha aloud with the Imam.
Listen to the Imam reciting a Sunnah Surah (e.g., Al-A'la or Qaf) aloud.
Rise up and perform 5 extra Takbirs, reciting the specific Dhikr between each.
Recite Surah Al-Fatiha aloud with the Imam.
Listen to the Imam reciting a Sunnah Surah (e.g., Al-Ghashiyah or Al-Qamar) aloud.
Sit for final Tashahhud and recite greetings.
Send complete blessings upon the Prophet.
Turn face right then left saying Salam to finish.
Raise hands, say the 1st Takbir with Niyyah, fold hands, and recite Surah Al-Fatiha quietly.
Raise hands, say the 2nd Takbir, and recite Salat al-Ibrahimiyyah (Durood).
Raise hands, say the 3rd Takbir, and recite the complete comprehensive Du'a for the deceased.
Raise hands, say the 4th Takbir, and recite the recommended brief Sunnah Du'a before Salaam.
Turn face right then left while standing, saying the Salaam to conclude the funeral prayer.
